title: Highest peaks above sea level (meters)

source.name: Joint Nepal-China re-survey of Mount Everest (Dec 8, 2020) and standard eight-thousander elevations
source.publisher: Survey Department of Nepal and Ministry of Natural Resources of China (joint survey), as reported by The Kathmandu Post

notes: Everest's official height was agreed at 8,848.86 m by Nepal and China on 8 December 2020 (rounded to 8,849 m here so the spoken and on-chart numbers match). K2 8,611 m, Kangchenjunga 8,586 m, Lhotse 8,516 m, Makalu 8,485 m are the standard published elevations of the next four highest peaks. Every value is measured from MEAN SEA LEVEL, which is the point of this beat.
